description: Shared test vectors for verbatim quotation matching (T04 R[1]). hub/rules (quote@1, quoteMatches in text.ts) and hub/refs (quoteMatches in quote.ts) must both pass every vector; each package reads this file in its tests and cross-check their independent implementations.
rule: Interior whitespace adjacent to any Unicode East_Asian_Width W/F code point is removed; every other run of Unicode White_Space (U+0009-U+000D, U+0020, U+0085, U+00A0, U+1680, U+2000-U+200A, U+2028, U+2029, U+202F, U+205F, U+3000) collapses to one space and both ends are trimmed, in the fragment and in the quote; then the quote must be a non-empty substring of the fragment. Case, punctuation, character width and Unicode normalization form stay significant.
